name: secure-saas-infra
description: Secure SaaS infrastructure baseline with centralized egress, EKS, Vault-ready secrets, and GitOps.

scripts.validate:gitops: kustomize build gitops/bootstrap/argocd >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/bootstrap/argocd/overlays/staging >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/bootstrap/argocd/overlays/production >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/dev/platform >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/dev/execution >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/staging/platform >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/staging/execution >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/production/platform >/dev/null && kustomize build gitops/overlays/production/execution >/dev/null
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run build && npm run policy:build && npm run validate:gitops
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:unit
